title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: The dialog asked to remove 320 unused declarations when 41 of those were renames of a lambda parameter to `_`, and the rest included locals and imports.

highlights.title: A rename is not a removal
highlights.description: The per file sweep does not only delete: it replaces an unused lambda parameter with `_`. On a real project that is 41 of the 320 changes the dialog was calling declarations. The question counts what it deletes now, and states the renames separately.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Remove Everything Unused counts deletions and renames separately, in the question it asks and in the report it ends on.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: The merge that folds five families into one edit drops 32 cuts, and every one of the 259 the families would produce alone is kept or contained in a kept one: nothing is lost.
A cut shrunk by one line is caught on all 87 cuts the shrinking actually changed; the other 11 are single line declarations the mutation left untouched.
